idea-plugin.name: ClickUp Integration
idea-plugin.description:
Work on your ClickUp tasks without leaving the IDE. ClickUp Integration adds ClickUp as a task server to the IDE's tasks support: open a ClickUp task, and the IDE switches your branch, changelist and editor context to it, keeps its status in ClickUp up to date and fills your commit message.

Features

  • Your ClickUp tasks in the IDE. Tools | Tasks & Contexts | Open Task lists the tasks of your workspace, assigned to you or to anyone, most recently updated first. Closed tasks on request.
  • Status updates. Move a task to any status of its ClickUp space when you open or finish it.
  • Branches and context. A branch and a changelist per task, and your editor tabs and breakpoints restored when you switch back.
  • Commit messages from the task. Placeholders for the task's ID, number, summary, project and type, plus Conventional Commits ones (${type}, ${scope}, ${description}, ${body}, ${footer}, ${breaking}): a ClickUp Bug becomes fix, a Task or Feature feat.
  • Custom task IDs. Use your workspace's custom IDs (like DEV-123) instead of ClickUp's internal ones.
  • Time tracking. Log the time you spent on a task to ClickUp.

Getting started

  1. Open Settings | Tools | Tasks | Servers, click + and choose ClickUp.
  2. Paste your personal ClickUp API token. Generate token opens the page in ClickUp where you create it (Settings | Apps).
  3. Pick your workspace and, optionally, an assignee, then click Test.
  4. Open a task with Tools | Tasks & Contexts | Open Task.

Compatibility

  • Every IntelliJ-based IDE from 2024.3 on: IntelliJ IDEA, PhpStorm, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, Rider and the others.
  • From 2026.3 on, the IDE's tasks support comes from the JetBrains Issue Trackers plugin, which is installed along with this one when your IDE doesn't bundle it.
  • Time tracking needs the IDE's time tracking feature: IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate up to 2025.3, the JetBrains Time Tracking plugin from 2026.3 on.

Open source, Apache 2.0: source and issues on GitHub. Not affiliated with or supported by ClickUp; the ClickUp logo is a trademark of ClickUp.
